notes: Reworks Market weapon cards so the canonical FEHA summary is the only weapon description shown.
Duplicate legacy rich-description blocks are removed even when they match the canonical effect text rather than containing the old generic base-damage wording.
The canonical weapon summary is placed directly before the Market action buttons instead of being appended below bottom-pinned controls.
Weapon cards now opt out of equal-height stretching and force action rows back into normal document flow, removing the huge empty vertical gaps visible on cards such as Knife Kurtz.
Neurotoxin Knife and other effect-heavy weapons now keep one clean effect summary plus the compact FEHA stat row, rather than showing the same text twice.
The Market remains MutationObserver-free, preserving the Shop freeze fix.
No prices, stock, weapon balance, DEX rules, reload cadence, armor, cyberware, grenades, or Quickhacks changed.
